description: This file defines interfaces and utility classes related to option formatting within the Orleans framework. It includes interfaces for formatting options, resolving formatters, and a utility class for formatting strings and option names.

classes.name: OptionFormattingUtilities
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for formatting key-value pairs and option names.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a key-value pair into a string using a specified or default format.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Generates a formatted name for an options object, optionally using a custom format string.
